answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 13 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 780 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. Without timber the panel is blind, without meadow the farm is free, and without cedar nobody can prove what happened.
